svg.text: Constant WLab hue against constant CIELAB hue
Each row is one lightness, from gray (left) to the most vivid color that fits on screen. Each chip is split:
upper left, constant WLab hue; lower right, the same L* and C*ab at the CIELAB hue of the ringed chip,
the darkest of the most vivid. Where the halves differ, the two kinds of hue line disagree.
CIE 1931 observer, D50 (the ICC profile connection space), shown through a Bradford adaptation to sRGB.
Each row sits on the gray of its own lightness. A dot marks a CIELAB half outside sRGB. Screen colors are approximate.
